# Vagrant Logistics Courier Calculator

> Premium web-based calculator for EVE Online courier contracts, optimised for the Amarr Empire aesthetic and precise real-time logistics calculations.

This repository contains the courier calculator used by Vagrant Logistics and The Charter alliance members to generate quotes based on volume, collateral, and route safety.

## Documentation

- [Project Overview](README.md): General documentation on getting started and running the application.
- [Vagrant Logistics Project Documentation](gemini.md): Historical context, design critique, branding personality, and development milestones.
- [Pricing Rates](rates.md): Strategic rates analysis, ship class definitions, and route pricing strategy.
- [Verification Test Cases](test-cases.md): Reference test cases and exact calculator reward expectations.

## Specifications

- [Pricing Configuration](rate_card_config.json): Active JSON pricing configuration defining base fees, per-jump fees, and collateral surcharges.
- [Fallow Configuration Specification](docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-05-fallow-config-and-coverage-design.md): Design specification for Fallow code quality metrics and testing coverage.

## Core Code

- [Main UI Layout](index.html): HTML5 structure following the Amarr Empire design language and glassmorphism styling.
- [Application Presentation Logic](app.js): Handles URL parameter parsing, local storage caching, UI events, and presentation updates.
- [Calculator Calculation Engine](calculator.js): Core pure reward calculation function and service classification logic.

- [Fallow Configuration Plan](docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-05-fallow-config-and-coverage-plan.md): Implementation details for setting up static analysis and coverage tools.
